description:
## Summary
Port the `/copy` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/copy` copies the last assistant message text to the system clipboard with no interactive UI.

Behavior details:
- Calls `getLastAssistantText()` to extract the most recent assistant turn's plain text
- Calls `copyToClipboard(text)` (platform-native clipboard write)
- Shows transient status: `showStatus("Copied last agent message to clipboard")`
- If there is no assistant message yet, the command is silently ignored (or shows a warning — confirm via source)

## Source References
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 5015 `handleCopyCommand()`
- Clipboard utility: search `copyToClipboard` in `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/`
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"copy"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"copy"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/copy` dispatch clause
3. Implement handler: get last assistant text from transcript, write to clipboard (use `xclip`/`pbcopy`/`wl-copy` as appropriate for platform), show status confirmation
4. Guard: if no assistant message exists, show appropriate warning
title: Port /copy command
